record.title: Paso del Norte CBP emergency suspension during migrant crowd arrival, March 12, 2023
record.scope: US-bound crossing of Paso del Norte international bridge
record.exceptions: No exceptions during reported suspension; evening reopening included pedestrians and one vehicle lane.
record.enforcement: CBP installed physical barriers and stopped traffic processing.
record.consequences: Traffic suspended and nearby bridges experienced separately unspecified disruptions.
record.status_observation: Evidence dated in cited sources; no assumption of present status.
record.official_rationale: CBP restricted entry after a large crowd sought to enter the United States.
record.context: Rumour of temporary admission and frustration with appointment access preceded crowd arrival; these are reported context.
record.uncertainty: Crowd arrival around noon and CBP hardening around 13:30 are distinct. Evening opening was partial; full lane restoration not established.

historical.duration_note: No supported continuous operational interval for the stated scope. Several hours; no computed zero-day interval.
